baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired verbs فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ join ح ش ر at word 1 to ن د و at word 2 through two immediate fa-transitions.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first root supplies not neutral aggregation but the driving of a group toward a common destination; the second supplies a raised call. The sequence first produces a concentrated audience and then addresses it.

activation_trace.role: Driving and collecting a group toward a destination makes the first verb an audience-producing action with a potentially coercive edge.
A raised, extended call supplies the audible act directed at the audience just produced.

changed_reading.after: He drove a group into one destination and immediately converted that concentration into an audience through a raised public summons.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: حَشَرَ and نَادَىٰ can both activate images of people brought into an assembly.
baseline_models.mechanism: The assembly image inside ن د و overlaps the gathering image inside ح ش ر. The two verbs can therefore describe one institutional operation: form a gathered public body and speak through that body, rather than perform two unrelated actions.

activation_trace.role: Collecting and driving a group supplies the material formation of the public body.
The club, council, or gathering image makes the assembled body itself the social medium of the call.

changed_reading.before: He collected people and afterward shouted.
changed_reading.after: He constituted the collected people as a public assembly and then addressed power through that assembly.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus links the concentration of ح ش ر with the reach and manifesting possibilities of ن د و.
baseline_models.mechanism: Concentration gives the call a social amplifier: voice travels across a gathered field and makes the speaker or message publicly apparent. Gathering is thus part of the communication technology, not mere prelude.

activation_trace.role: A group driven to one destination supplies a concentrated field across which publicity can operate.
The range and distance of a voice contribute communicative reach beyond a bare utterance.
Appearance and notification make the call an act of public manifestation as well as sound.

changed_reading.before: The gathering and call are two successive acts.
changed_reading.after: The gathering is the amplifier by which the call gains range, visibility, and public force.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding turn-away and purposeful striving feed directly into the two fa-linked focus verbs. Gathering and calling now look like the operational result of a deliberate counter-movement, not a spontaneous announcement.

activation_trace.role: Driving a group toward one destination supplies the mobilization accomplished in the focus.
The assembly image supplies the organized social body produced by that mobilization.
Turning the back and withdrawing supplies the initial reversal away from the preceding encounter.
Purposeful motion toward an objective turns withdrawal into active preparation for the focus sequence.

structural_cues: 79:22 uses ثُمَّ before 79:23 accelerates through فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ.
The same unstated subject controls the turn, striving, gathering, and calling sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withdrawal, purposeful movement, driven gathering, and assembly; I infer an execution arrow from the movement to organized mobilization. A live alternative is that سَعَىٰ marks haste only, leaving the gathering less administratively planned.

changed_reading.before: He gathered a crowd and called to it.
changed_reading.after: After reversing course, he deliberately mobilized a public body and activated it with a call as his counter-move.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah supplies the otherwise unstated content of the call as a claim of supreme lordship. The gathered assembly functions as witness and medium, so the call does not merely report authority; it attempts to manufacture authority through public uptake.

activation_trace.role: Collecting people into one destination creates the witness body needed for a public sovereignty claim.
The raised call turns the claim into an audible public performance.
The image of a speaker whose saying carries force makes the following utterance an attempted act of rule.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty supply the claimed office that the call publicly asserts.
A call of self-exaltation supplies the vertical superlative performed over the gathered addressees.

structural_cues: 79:24 begins with another fa and immediately gives direct speech after the objectless call of 79:23.
The second-person plural suffix in رَبُّكُمُ makes the assembled plurality the explicit addressee of the claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies audience formation, public voicing, and the immediate claim of highest lordship; I infer that the crowd's witnessing is meant to enact the claim. The materially live alternative is a merely chronological report in which the crowd does not confer performative force.

changed_reading.before: He gathered people and announced a claim to them.
changed_reading.after: He manufactured a political public so that its collective hearing could perform his claim to supreme sovereignty.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, one vocal rebuke is enough for an immediate collective emergence, whereas the focus ruler must first drive together an audience and then call. This scale contrast makes his convocation a laborious local counter-call beneath a single overwhelming summons.

activation_trace.role: The driven local gathering supplies the humanly constructed side of the contrast.
The ruler's raised call supplies the local vocal act echoed and diminished by the earlier summons.
A rebuke delivered by voice supplies a compact summons that can be compared with the focus call.
Numerical oneness makes the earlier vocal event singular rather than an extended mobilization campaign.

structural_cues: The fa-sequence of 79:13-14 makes one voiced event yield an immediate collective scene; 79:23 also binds gathering and calling with fa.
The whole-surah placement lets the resurrection sequence precede and frame the ruler's smaller sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two vocal sequences and sharply different scales of preparation; I infer a contrast in effective summoning power. A live alternative is that the resemblance is rhythmic only and does not make the focus call an imitation or counter-call.

changed_reading.before: The ruler conducts a local public assembly.
changed_reading.after: His gathering and call stage a small, effortful counter-convocation whose apparent command is already dwarfed by the surah's single effective summons.

context_deltas.mechanism: The agent who drove others into a gathering is immediately made the object of seizure, and his public self-proclamation is converted into a deterrent punishment for others. Agency and publicity both reverse: the collector is collected, and his intended audience becomes the horizon of his example.

activation_trace.role: Driving and collecting others supplies the initial direction of control that the next sequence reverses.
Public manifestation supplies the visibility later reassigned from his claim to his punishment.
Grasping and capture reverse the focus subject from controller of a gathered body into the controlled object.
Punishment that deters observers converts the ruler's sought publicity into publicity against him.

structural_cues: 79:24 completes the proclaimed claim, and 79:25 immediately changes the grammatical agent to God and the ruler to an object suffix.
The repeated initial fa keeps gathering, proclamation, claim, and seizure in a rapid causal-looking chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a subject who gathers and manifests, followed by his capture and exemplary punishment; I infer a designed role reversal and transfer of publicity. The audience of the deterrent need not be identical to the crowd he assembled, so that continuity remains inferential.

changed_reading.before: The focus is the climax of the ruler's successful control over a crowd.
changed_reading.after: The focus is the hinge that exposes control as reversible: the collector's public triumph prepares his own seizure and conversion into a public warning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The narrative labels the ruler's condition as boundary-crossing before the focus, then the closing general pattern repeats that root and couples it with self-directed preference. The focus supplies a concrete social mechanism for that pattern: appropriate a plurality, concentrate it around oneself, and make one's voice dominant over it.

activation_trace.role: Driving a plurality toward one destination supplies the social material appropriated by the ruler.
The raised call supplies the dominance of one voice over the concentrated plurality.
Crossing the limit in disobedience labels the condition that motivates the encounter and frames the later mobilization.
The repeated boundary-crossing image generalizes the ruler's narrative pattern near the surah's close.
Self-appropriation supplies the inward direction of the public operation: the many are made to serve the claimant's own elevation.

structural_cues: The exact root ط غ ي occurs in 79:17 before the ruler episode and again in the generalized pattern at 79:37.
79:38 immediately follows the generalized transgressor with an act of preference, allowing the focus episode to function as a worked social example.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated transgression, self-directed appropriation, driven gathering, and a dominant call; I infer that the focus dramatizes how transgression becomes social organization. A live alternative is that the closing preference concerns only personal valuation and does not illuminate crowd management.

changed_reading.before: Gathering and calling are incidental tactics used by a transgressing ruler.
changed_reading.after: Gathering and calling expose the social mechanics of transgression: commandeer the many and center their public field on the self.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant و س م mapping for the س م و occurrence at 'sky' in 79:27, not that occurrence's surface sense. It remains traceable because its marked season where people gather converges exactly with the focus roots' driven gathering and council images. Downstream prose should present this only as a possible activation toward a staged public occasion, never as a translation of سَمَآءُ or as a settled reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The outlier remains attached to حَشَرَ as mass collection and نَادَىٰ as formation of a public assembly.

activation_trace.role: Driven collection toward a destination supplies the mass attendance of the proposed occasion.
Council and public gathering supply the occasion's organized civic form.
A marked season or venue to which people gather activates the possibility that the focus describes staging a recognizable mass event.

changed_reading.before: He assembled people and called to them.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, he staged a marked mass occasion whose assembled public was designed for the proclamation.

strongest_changes: The two verbs form an audience-production mechanism: driven concentration becomes the medium of a raised public call.
The following lordship claim turns that mechanism into performative sovereignty, with the crowd serving as witness rather than background.
The next seizure reverses both agency and publicity, converting the collector and caller into the object of a public deterrent.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package made the tiny two-verb focus expand in two directions at once: locally into an institutional ritual of rule, and globally into a diminished counter-convocation framed by the surah's more effective summons and final reversal.
remaining_uncertainties: ح ش ر clearly includes gathering toward a destination, but the degree of coercion carried by this occurrence remains uncertain.
The comparison with the single vocal event in 79:13 may be a designed power contrast or only a structural echo.
The marked-occasion outlier depends on a non-dominant split-root branch and should remain explicitly exploratory.
